overview.lead: Human racials changed on 26 October: Ruthless now gives +1% crit and the Spirit racial +10% Spirit.

points.text: The class guides name Humans for Warrior, Paladin, Hunter, Rogue, Priest, Mage and Warlock. Human Hunters are new in Forever.
No racial grants weapon skill in Forever, so a Human's weapon choice is free of racial math.

101.summary: The Human racials in numbers and the Human versions of class quests.

steps.text: Count +1% crit from Ruthless. The 2% in older guides is out of date since 26 October.
Count +10% Spirit from the Human Spirit racial.
Leave weapon skill out of your plans: no racial grants it in Forever.

mistakes.mistake: Using a guide written before 26 October that gives Ruthless 2% crit.
mistakes.fix: Ruthless is +1% crit since the 26 October notes.

mistakes.mistake: Choosing Human for a weapon-skill bonus.
mistakes.fix: No racial grants weapon skill in Forever.

steps.text: As a Human Warrior, take the Bartleby quest at level 10: it unlocks Defensive Stance and rewards Bartleby's Mug.
As a Human Priest, plan the racial spell quests at levels 10 and 20.
Expect Divine Grace and Feedback as the Human Priest's racial spells.

mistakes.mistake: Following another race's Defensive Stance quest as a Human Warrior.
mistakes.fix: The Human version is the Bartleby quest, which rewards Bartleby's Mug.
